newsitem.title: UK: Reckitt shares off as Hoare downgrades. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Reckitt shares off as Hoare downgrades. [CORRECTED 14:45 GMT]

text.p: Shares in Reckitt and Colman Plc fell on Friday as analysts at Hoare Govett trimmed their recommendation on the household products group to "undervalued" from "buy". (Corrects new recommendation from "overvalued" to "undervalued").
The shares were down 16p at 807-1/2 by 1245 GMT.

"The shares have had a very strong run in the last month on the back of rumours of a Unilever takeover," Hoare Govett analyst Duncan Fox said. "We don't believe Unilever will do anything in the short term."
Fox said he expected Reckitt and Colman's annual results to be "pretty good" when they were announced on Thursday.
"But it has reached our target of getting to a market rating and is likely to consolidate in the near term," he said.
